items.text: Seattle put tight end Elijah Arroyo (SEA) on IR Thursday, and he needs shoulder surgery that ends his season, per ESPN's Adam Schefter. AJ Barner played 93 percent of the snaps after Arroyo got hurt at DEN and is TE21 for me vs KC, outside my top 12. Drop Arroyo for any add on the list.

George Pickens (DAL) showed up on the injury report for the first time this season, limited Thursday with the shoulder, and is on track for Monday night at PHI. WR18 for me this week, a WR2, and WR12 rest of season. Monitor Dallas' Friday injury report.

Christian Watson (GB) was limited Thursday with the ankle, and Matthew Golden was limited with the shoulder. Watson played 90 percent of the snaps vs DAL and is WR7 for me this week at DET. Monitor Green Bay's Friday injury report.
Matthew Golden (GB) was limited Thursday with the shoulder after 13 targets vs DAL. WR8 for me this week at DET. Monitor Green Bay's Friday injury report.

Alvin Kamara (NO) was limited Thursday with the back, while CJ Donaldson moved up to a full practice with the shoulder. Kamara is RB25 for me vs PIT, a high-end RB3, with Kendre Miller right behind him at RB26. Monitor New Orleans' Friday injury report.

Dalton Schultz (HOU) moved up to a limited practice Thursday with the quad, and Tank Dell practiced in full ahead of his return vs NYG. Schultz is TE18 for me this week, outside my top 12, with Dell and Marvin Harrison Jr. adding mouths; sit him outside deep leagues.

Jordan Mason (MIN) practiced in full Thursday, but Minnesota had not activated him off IR. If he is activated, he takes the early downs vs IND and is RB28 for me this week, a high-end RB3 and a high-end flex play. Monitor his activation off IR by Saturday.
Travis Kelce (KC) was limited again Thursday with the right ankle, and left tackle Josh Simmons went to IR with a bulging disc. Kelce is TE8 for me at SEA. Monitor Kansas City's Friday injury report.

Lamar Jackson (BAL) was limited again Thursday with the ankle, his second straight limited day, while Rashod Bateman moved up to a full practice with the shoulder. Tyler Huntley starts vs CIN if Lamar sits. QB17 for me this week, a streamer, outside my top 12 until he practices in full, and QB2 rest of season. Monitor Baltimore's Friday injury report.
Bucky Irving (TB) was limited Thursday with the illness after missing Wednesday. RB12 for me this week at CAR, borderline RB1/RB2. Monitor Tampa Bay's Friday injury report.

Emeka Egbuka (TB) did not practice Thursday, still in the concussion protocol with the foot injury too. WR41 for me this week, a low-end flex play to a dart throw, only if he clears the protocol. Monitor his concussion status on Friday's injury report.

Breece Hall (NYJ) was limited Thursday with the quad after missing Wednesday. Braelon Allen (NYJ) played 87 percent of the snaps in Week 6 and holds RB13 for me this week only if Hall is ruled out; if Hall plays, Allen drops to a split and the flex range. Hall is RB17 rest of season for me. Monitor the Jets' Friday designation.

Tyler Warren (IND) did not practice Thursday with the groin, his second straight missed day, and Keenan Allen drew 11 targets when Warren sat in Week 6. Warren is outside my top 12 this week and TE7 rest of season for me. Monitor Indianapolis' Friday injury report.

Justin Jefferson (MIN) practiced in full Thursday with the ankle after a limited Wednesday, and Colts cornerback Sauce Gardner missed practice again with the calf. WR9 for me this week vs IND. Monitor Minnesota's Friday injury report.

Rashee Rice (KC) did not practice Thursday with the hamstring and knee, his second straight missed day this week, and he is off my Week 7 rankings at SEA. WR21 rest of season for me. Monitor Kansas City's Friday injury report for his designation.
Jordan Love (GB) practiced in full Thursday with the back after a limited Wednesday. QB3 for me this week at DET. Monitor Green Bay's Friday injury report for his designation.

David Montgomery (HOU) did not practice Thursday with the groin and is expected to miss Week 7 vs NYG, per Aaron Wilson of the Houston Chronicle, and Houston is on bye in Week 8. RB25 rest of season for me. Monitor Houston's Friday injury report for his designation.
items.watch: Houston's Friday injury report for his designation

items.text: Woody Marks (HOU) played 78 percent of the snaps at JAX and every snap inside the 5, and David Montgomery is expected to miss Week 7. RB16 for me vs NYG this week, an RB2.

Brevyn Spann-Ford started over Jake Ferguson (DAL) in Week 6, per the Fort Worth Star-Telegram, and Ferguson ran a route on about half the dropbacks and caught 2 for 13. TE24 for me at PHI, outside my top 12, and TE17 rest of season; sit him outside deep leagues and watch his routes Monday night.

items.watch: Denver's Friday injury report for Pat Surtain II
items.text: Denver cornerback Pat Surtain II returned to practice Wednesday with the ankle before the Broncos play at ARI. Michael Wilson (ARI) is WR24 for me this week, a WR2, and a Surtain shadow would cost him targets. Monitor Denver's Friday injury report for Surtain.
Colts cornerback Sauce Gardner did not practice Wednesday with the calf and is week to week. Kyler Murray (MIN) comes off the bye vs IND and is QB11 for me, a borderline start this week.

Chig Okonkwo (WAS) ran a route on more than 80 percent of the dropbacks at SF and caught all 7 targets for 69, a week after a team-high 6 targets, and Terry McLaurin is out for the season. TE19 rest of season for me. Stash him through the bye, 1 to 3 percent of FAAB.

Antonio Williams (WAS) ran a route on 73, 76 and 74 percent of the dropbacks in Weeks 4 to 6 and led Washington's receivers in routes at SF, with Terry McLaurin out for the season. WR66 rest of season for me. Stash him through the bye, 1 to 3 percent of FAAB.

Rachaad White (WAS) played about 70 percent of the snaps at SF with Jacory Croskey-Merritt out, and caught 4 of 5 targets for 30 and a TD. Croskey-Merritt is on IR with the groin for at least four games. RB38 rest of season for me. Stash White through the bye, 2 to 4 percent of FAAB.
Carnell Tate (TEN) drew 32 percent of Tennessee's targets at IND and accounted for 70 of Cam Ward's 102 passing yards. WR25 for me vs CLE this week, a high-end WR3, and WR29 rest of season.

items.why: Barkley being ruled out Saturday or inactive Monday puts Pierce back in the RB2 range.
items.text: Dameon Pierce (PHI) played 61 of 64 snaps vs CAR with Saquon Barkley inactive, and that share goes back to Barkley now. Philadelphia waived Jaydon Blue, put Carson Steele on waived/injured and signed Elijah Mitchell to the practice squad, so Pierce is the only backup. RB33 for me this week, a low-end RB3; sit him and hold him as the handcuff unless Barkley is ruled out.

Denver designated Jonah Coleman (DEN) to return from IR Wednesday and he practiced, opening his 21-day window from the high ankle sprain. His activation cuts into J.K. Dobbins' early downs; Dobbins is RB23 for me this week, an RB2. Coleman is RB49 rest of season. Stash him, 2 to 4 percent of FAAB, and hold him where he is rostered.

items.watch: Philadelphia's Saturday injury report and Monday's inactives
items.text: Saquon Barkley (PHI) practiced in full Thursday from the hamstring, and ESPN reports he is expected to play Monday vs DAL after missing two games. RB29 for me this week, a high-end RB3, and RB12 rest of season. Monitor Philadelphia's Saturday injury report and Monday's inactives.

Baker Mayfield (TB) practiced in full Wednesday and Thursday on the right thumb, and Todd Bowles decides Friday whether he or Jalon Daniels starts at CAR. Mayfield is outside my top 12 this week and QB29 rest of season for me. Monitor Todd Bowles' Friday decision.

items.watch: his route share vs NYG Sunday
items.text: DeMeco Ryans said Tank Dell (HOU) will play Sunday vs NYG, his first game since December 2024. He plays the slot, so Jaylin Noel loses routes first; Noel ran 63 percent of the routes in Week 6. Monitor Dell's route share vs NYG Sunday before you add him.
Josh Jacobs (GB) practiced Thursday in his first week back from the exempt list. RB17 for me this week at DET, an RB2, and RB22 rest of season. Monitor Green Bay's Friday injury report.

items.watch: his snap share vs KC Sunday
items.text: Seattle activated Zach Charbonnet (SEA) off PUP Thursday after a full practice Wednesday, so he plays vs KC in his first game since the ACL. The fill-ins split 46 and 27 snaps Sunday. He is RB37 for me this week, a low-end flex play to a dart throw, so sit him for his first game; RB40 rest of season. Monitor his snap share vs KC Sunday.

Jeremiyah Love (ARI) did not practice Wednesday with the ankle and is expected to miss Week 7 vs DEN, per the Cardinals' report. Bam Knight (ARI) ran 15 times for 80 with most of the red-zone touches the last time Love sat, and he leads the early downs once Love is ruled out. Love is RB15 rest of season for me. Monitor Arizona's Friday injury report for both.

items.watch: his practice window opening, Week 8 or later
items.text: Adam Schefter reports Terrance Ferguson (LAR) is expected to stay on IR past his Week 8 eligibility with the ankle, and his recovery will take some time. TE22 rest of season for me, and no FAAB yet; Tyler Higbee is TE10 for me this week at LV. Monitor Ferguson's practice window opening, Week 8 or later.

T.J. Hockenson (MIN) practiced in full Wednesday but is still in the concussion protocol and not cleared for Sunday vs IND. He is TE14 for me this week, a borderline start, only if he clears; Kyle Pitts Sr. is the pivot if he is ruled out. Monitor Friday's injury report.

items.why: He returns around Week 11 at the earliest; with no IR spot open, drop him for any add.
items.text: Jacory Croskey-Merritt (WAS) is on IR with the groin and out at least four games, about Weeks 8 to 11 after the bye. RB43 rest of season for me. Hold him in an IR spot; with no IR spot open, drop him for any add on the list.
Jauan Jennings (MIN) has 2 catches for 9 yards in four games, and Tom Pelissero does not expect Minnesota to trade him. WR73 rest of season for me. Drop him for any add on the list.

Chicago ruled out Kyle Monangai (CHI) for Thursday vs NE with the thumb and toe after he missed every walkthrough this week, his third straight game out. D'Andre Swift leads the backfield again and is RB10 for me this week. Monangai is RB34 rest of season for me; hold him, and a missed practice next week makes him a drop.
items.why: A missed practice next week, after a third straight game out, makes him a drop.

items.text: John Harbaugh named J.J. McCarthy (NYG) the starter at HOU over Jameis Winston. McCarthy threw for 243 yards, a TD and an interception in relief vs NO, most of it after the Giants fell behind 34-10. He is outside my top 12 this week. Monitor his first start at Houston Sunday before you add him in superflex leagues.
items.watch: his first start at Houston Sunday

items.text: Mike Evans (SF) did not practice Wednesday with the Achilles tendinitis and is expected to miss Sunday at ATL, with San Francisco's bye after it, so Week 9 is the earliest return. WR23 rest of season for me. Hold him on your bench; a missed practice after the bye makes him a sell.
items.why: Week 9 is the earliest return; a missed practice after the bye makes him a sell.

items.text: Quinshon Judkins (CLE) was limited Wednesday with the ankle after missing Week 6, and Todd Monken is optimistic he plays at TEN. He is RB20 rest of season for me and outside my top 40 backs this week until he practices in full. Monitor Cleveland's Friday injury report.

Kyle Shanahan said Christian Kirk (SF) is a possibility for Sunday at ATL after two good practices with the calf, and Mike Evans (Achilles) looks unlikely to play. Kirk is still on IR and has not played a snap this season, so he would step into a receiver room missing its top target. Add him in 12-team leagues, 0 to 2 percent of FAAB.

items.why: No practice window opening after the Week 8 bye makes him a drop.
items.text: Saints GM Mickey Loomis said Jordyn Tyson (NO) won't practice this week with the hamstring but is getting closer. New Orleans plays PIT in Paris Sunday and then has its Week 8 bye, so Tyson has at least two more weeks on IR. WR46 rest of season for me. Hold him in an IR spot; no practice window after the bye makes him a drop.

Tuesday's MRI showed a torn patellar tendon in the left knee of Terry McLaurin (WAS), and Dan Quinn said he needs surgery and misses the rest of the season. Stefon Diggs is the top receiver when Washington returns in Week 8, WR34 rest of season for me. Drop McLaurin for any add; hold Diggs.

items.why: A second straight game with Corey Kiner taking the late carries makes him a sell.
items.text: TreVeyon Henderson (NE) practiced in full Monday and Tuesday on the ankle before Thursday at CHI, but Corey Kiner closed out the Jets after Henderson's fumble. RB28 rest of season for me. Hold Henderson; a second straight game with Kiner taking the late carries makes him a sell.

items.why: Missing Wednesday's practice before the Thursday game changes it.
items.text: A.J. Brown (NE) was limited Monday and Tuesday with the ankle but is not expected to miss Thursday at CHI. He ran a route on 97 percent of the dropbacks and drew 10 targets vs NYJ, and Romeo Doubs is on IR. WR18 rest of season for me; hold him through the drops.

Kyle Monangai (CHI) missed practice again Tuesday with the thumb and toe and is very unlikely to play Thursday vs NE, a third straight game out. RB34 rest of season for me. Monitor Chicago's Wednesday practice report. D'Andre Swift leads the backfield again, RB13 rest of season for me; hold him.

Jaylin Noel (HOU) caught 4 for 107 and a TD on 4 targets at JAX on 63 percent of the routes, but Tank Dell returns to share the slot vs NYG. Add him in deep leagues, 1 to 3 percent of FAAB and no more.
MarShawn Lloyd (GB) ran 8 times for 10 and played 30 snaps vs DAL, 11 fewer than the back ahead of him, and Josh Jacobs is eligible again. RB55 rest of season for me; drop him for any add.

items.watch: his activation off IR before Sunday vs IND
items.text: Minnesota designated Jordan Mason (MIN) to return from IR, opening his practice window before Week 7 vs IND, and he takes early downs once active. RB33 rest of season for me. Monitor his activation before Sunday; hold Aaron Jones Sr. until then.
Jesse Minter called Lamar Jackson (BAL) day to day with the ankle and said he could practice this week. QB2 rest of season for me. Monitor Baltimore's Wednesday practice report.

The Giants released Najee Harris (NYG) on Tuesday, per NFL Network's Ian Rapoport and ESPN's Jordan Raanan, after 31 carries for 99 yards in five games, 3.2 a carry, and 4 for 2 vs NO. Drop him in every format.

With Najee Harris gone, the Giants are down to three backs at Houston: Devin Singletary played 40 percent of the snaps vs NO, Tyrone Tracy Jr. (NYG) 38 percent with two TDs on 8 touches, and Cam Skattebo 6 snaps. Add Tracy, 0 to 2 percent of FAAB; he is the bench piece if John Harbaugh leans on him.

Mike Evans (SF) has Achilles tendinitis that flared up Monday night, and Kyle Shanahan said it is not a long-term problem. NBC Sports Bay Area reports the Achilles is intact but San Francisco is bracing for him to miss at ATL, with the bye in Week 8. He is WR23 rest of season for me. Monitor; San Francisco's Wednesday practice report.

Baker Mayfield (TB) is set to practice Wednesday on the dislocated right thumb, but Fox Sports' Greg Auman reports Todd Bowles is still planning for Jalon Daniels to make a fourth straight start at CAR. Mayfield is QB29 rest of season for me. Monitor; Tampa Bay's Wednesday practice report.
